headline: He Asked ‘Why Such a Nice Girl Would Paint Such Wild Pictures.’ The Rest Is Art History.
context: Gallerists have uncovered rare works by Marguerite and William Zorach, shining light on the pioneering collaborators. Their modern art love story bows at the Independent 20th Century fair.
